name: YJ Big 3x3 (16.8cm)
description: The YJ Big 3x3 (16.8cm) brings a whole new dimension to classic cubing. This giant 3x3 puzzle features a massive 16.8cm (6.61 inch) edge-length, making it a standout piece in any collection. Its vibrant stickerless colors ensure that every turn looks stunning, while the robust internal mechanism delivers smooth and reliable turning straight out of the box.
